title: Arnoldo Bettelini Scholarships
description: The descendants of Arnoldo Bettelini, a Swiss naturalist and philanthropist who promoted the foundation of a University in the Italian-speaking part of Switzerland, are offering a scholarship to cover the tuition fees of a Master’s programme at the Università della Svizzera itali

blocks.html:
2026-2027

Provider: Discendenti di Arnoldo Bettelini

Submission deadline: 31 August 2026

Number of scholarships: 1

The descendants of Arnoldo Bettelini, a Swiss naturalist and philanthropist who promoted the foundation of a University in the Italian-speaking part of Switzerland, are offering a scholarship to cover the tuition fees of a Master’s programme at the Università della Svizzera italiana (both Lugano and Mendrisio campus), up to a maximum 4'000 CHF per academic year. Call in Italian only
